notes.title: Day 1 Patch: A small but important wooden plank!
notes.content: We fixed the bug with climbing the stairs - we put a wooden plank under it. Now not a single step is not a hindrance!

notes.title: Day 0.5 Patch: Fighting bugs ASAP!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where you couldn’t move after looking through the peephole. You're free to roam again!
[*] Fixed a bug where the game froze if you looked through the peephole with a beer. Beer compatibility improved!
[*] Removed the ability to leave the hole with the drawing when you weren’t supposed to. Naughty, naughty!
[*] Fixed a bug with the numbers on the staircase. They’ve been disciplined.
[*] Fixed a bug with the second beer in the matryoshka. Only one beer per nesting doll, please!
[/list]
